incident.what: A release report claimed '130+ items'. A recount from a clean clone found 103.
incident.signal: Caught by a reviewer who recounted instead of trusting the number.

root_cause: Numbers were carried from memory across edits and never re-measured.

law.text: Every quantitative claim is measured at the moment it is written, by a command whose output is pasted next to the claim. Release verification is done from a clean clone, never from the working tree.
checks: each number in a report has an adjacent command + output
release checks run in a fresh clone

notes: De-identified from a real operating incident. Names, systems and paths removed; the mechanism is kept.
